MY LETTER TO YOU ♥

I LOVE YOU BETA 😘

I love you so much. Maybe I'll never be able to explain just how much I love you.

Tumko pata hai, jab hum dono pehli baar mile the, us waqt mujhe bilkul nahi pata tha ki tum meri life mein itni special ho jaogi.

Pata hai beta, tumhara jo favourite song hai na, use jab bhi sunta hoon, pata nahi kyun, lekin achanak aankhon mein aansu aa jaate hain.

Aur beta, mujhe yaad hai ek baar maine tumse kaha tha ki aukaat se bada sochna chahiye. Log kehte hain ki “jitni chadar ho, utne hi pair failane chahiye,” lekin maine kaha tha, “Ye galat hai, doosri chadar kharid lenge.” 😄 Yaad hai, is baat par tum kitna hansi thi?

Aur ek baar tumne kaha tha ki dadi ki tabiyat kharab hai, mausi aayengi to mithai lekar aayengi, isliye tum bahut saari mithai khaogi. Ye baat bolkar tum kitna hasti thi, yaad hai? 😄

Sach bolun, tum jab bhi hasti ho na, to mujhe andar se bahut sukoon milta hai. 😊❤️

Sach kahu to, main tumse khud se bhi zyada pyaar karta hoon. Itna pyaar karta hoon ki tumhare liye kisi ke aage jhukna pade, to main jhuk jaunga.

Sab bolte hain ki apni pasandida aurat se, “Main tumhara matha chum kar pyaar karunga.”

Lekin main kehta hoon, main to tumhare pair bhi chum lunga. Tum jab bhi mujhe daantogi, to main tumse kabhi jawab nahi ladunga, balki chup rehkar tumhari baat sununga. Promise, tumhe hamesha khud se zyada pyaar karunga, beta. 😊❤️

I I I I love you, bachha. 😊❤️

I loved you.
I love you.
I will always love you, beta. 😊💟

Main tumhe kabhi jaan-bujhkar ignore nahi karunga, aur hamesha tumhare liye loyal rahunga, beta. 😊❤️

I love you so much. ❤️

Always yours,
Satyam (Prince) ❤️😊😊
